description: Paid: 0.001 RLUSD per call via x402 on XRPL mainnet (xrpl:0), or 0.001 USDC on Base (eip155:8453). Pay per call, solves one question: What is the worst current level across status pages, facilitator reachability, and recent changes? Raw storm/level/reason plus observed_* samples with sources. Without payment this returns isError with the x402 PaymentRequired object (fresh invoiceId); retry with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"] or the payment_signature argument. Unpaid calls cost nothing.

payment_signature.description: Optional. Base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value (signed RLUSD or USDC PaymentPayload) for hosts that cannot set _meta["x402/payment"]. Omit on the first call to receive the payment requirements.

name: get_pulse_storm
title: Pulse: storm signal (paid: 0.001 RLUSD / 0.001 USDC on Base / 0.001 RLUSD on Base via x402)
